data: What is the approximate accuracy value of the solid purple line in the first graph when the number of hops is 4?

The solid purple line represents the model with no node pair loss weight. From the caption, we know that adding node pair loss helps predict long-distance nodes better. Therefore, the solid purple line will have lower accuracy than the other lines for larger hop counts. 

Looking at the graph, the solid purple line appears to be around 65% accuracy when the number of hops is 4. This is consistent with the trend described in the caption, where adding node pair loss improves accuracy for longer distances.
